key.name: shortcut-primary
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to toggle Quick Light search modal.

key.name: shortcut-secondary
key.description: Optional alternate keyboard shortcut to toggle Quick Light.

key.name: popup-at-cursor
key.description: Display the spotlight search box on the monitor containing the mouse pointer.

key.name: preferred-monitor
key.description: Index of preferred display monitor (0 for primary).

key.name: monitor-count
key.description: Cached count of connected display outputs.

key.name: window-width-scale
key.description: Fraction of monitor width added to base window width.

key.name: window-height-scale
key.description: Fraction of monitor height added to base results box height.

key.name: border-radius
key.description: Border radius in pixels for the search window container.

key.name: border-thickness
key.description: Border thickness in pixels (0 for none).

key.name: border-color
key.description: RGBA color tuple for the spotlight window outline border.

key.name: background-color
key.description: RGBA color tuple for the floating modal background.

key.name: text-color
key.description: RGBA color tuple for search text (alpha 0 for system default).

key.name: indicator-color
key.description: RGBA color tuple for status bar panel indicator.

key.name: entry-font-size
key.description: Font size in points for the search entry field.

key.name: results-font-size
key.description: Font size in points for results lists.

key.name: enable-animations
key.description: Smooth fade and scale transitions when opening/closing modal.

key.name: show-panel-indicator
key.description: Display quick-toggle icon in GNOME Shell status area.
